events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album', was released in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling, iconic 'White Album'. Which track still stands out for you?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's passing remembered
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, passed away at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 today. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', in 1965, marking a significant artistic progression for the band.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that showed their incredible evolution.

events.title: John Lennon's passing remembered
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles co-founder, John Lennon. He was 40 years old.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His enduring legacy continues to inspire generations.

events.title: David Bowie turns 80
events.blurb: The iconic 'Starman' David Bowie would have turned 80 today.

angles.name: Bowie 80th Birthday
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible life and artistry of David Bowie, who would have been 80 today. His influence is truly immeasurable.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis 92nd Birthday
angles.copy: The King, Elvis Presley, would have been 92 today. His music is still moving generations.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Jimmy Page 83rd Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the iconic Led Zeppelin axe-man, Jimmy Page! What's your favourite riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British rock and pop legend Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod Stewart 82nd Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 82nd Birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! Still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Graham 'Suggs' McPherson celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Suggs 66th Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to the legendary Suggs from Madness! Still making us skank in our kitchen.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young 71st Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 71st Birthday to the blue-eyed soul man, Paul Young! Still got that smooth voice.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: The beloved country music icon Dolly Parton, who passed away in 2026, would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly Parton Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Dolly Parton, who would have been 81 today. Her legacy shines brighter than a rhinestone cowboy.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary Barlow 56th Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 56th Birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! What's your favourite track he penned?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Billy Ocean 77th Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the brilliant Billy Ocean! Get outta our dreams and into our cars, playing his hits all day.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame first induction
events.blurb: The first-ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame was held in 1989, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Rock Hall Inaugural
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years since the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame inducted its first class of legends. Who was your favourite from that original lineup?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That singer-songwriter Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark Owen 55th Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 55th Birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still charming the nation after all these years.

events.title: The Beatles' famous rooftop concert anniversary
events.blurb: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles performed their iconic and final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Concert 58th
angles.copy: It's 58 years since The Beatles played their legendary rooftop concert in London. Imagine being one of the lucky few who heard it live!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Grammy-winning English singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil Collins 76th Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 76th Birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! In the Air Tonight still gives us chills.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant, known for his roles in romantic comedies, celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Hugh Grant 67th Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 67th Birthday to Hugh Grant! From rom-com king to brilliant character actor, he's always a joy to watch.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Justin Timberlake 46th Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 46th Birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From boyband to solo superstar, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Veteran English actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles like Del Boy and Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: David Jason 87th Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! A true legend of British television.

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died', when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash in 1959.

angles.name: Day The Music Died
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years since 'The Day The Music Died'. Remembering Buddy Holly (would have been 91), Ritchie Valens (would have been 86), and The Big Bopper (would have been 97). Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Rick Astley, known for his 80s mega-hit 'Never Gonna Give You Up', celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Rick Astley 61st Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 61st Birthday to Rick Astley! We're never gonna give him up, we're never gonna let him down.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae icon Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Bob Marley 82nd Birthday
angles.copy: Remembering the legend, Bob Marley, who would have been 82 today. His message of peace and unity resonates more than ever.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Acclaimed American singer-songwriter Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Carole King 85th Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 85th Birthday to the songwriting genius, Carole King! Tapestry remains a masterpiece.

events.title: Whitney Houston's passing remembered
events.blurb: Today marks 15 years since the tragic death of 'The Voice', Whitney Houston. She passed away at 48.

angles.name: Whitney Houston Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible Whitney Houston, who would have been 64 today. Her voice was pure magic.

events.title: Take That split anniversary
events.blurb: It's 31 years since the original Take That lineup announced their split, breaking hearts across the nation.

angles.name: Take That Split 31st
angles.copy: Thirty-one years ago, the original Take That called it a day. We're still not over it, but at least they came back!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 co-founder and lead singer Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Ali Campbell 68th Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the voice of UB40, Ali Campbell! 'Red Red Wine' still sounds as good as ever.
